name: athfuelpath-web
_overrides_note: Both entries patch a package that only reaches us THROUGH next, which is
why they are overrides rather than dependency bumps: the alternative was
next 15 -> 16, a major version, to fix two transitive packages.
sharp — next pins its own range and npm nests a separate copy, so the
0.35.3 listed in dependencies above did nothing for it; the vulnerable
0.34.5 was the one running image optimisation on the server. That is the
runtime half of the pair and the reason this was worth doing.
postcss — build-time only, and the CSS it reads is ours. Patched because
it is a minor bump, not because a traversal in our own stylesheets is a
plausible attack. Drop both when next no longer needs them.
